author: Claude Opus 5.5 for the 2026-11-23 talk, exploratory
design: Each pair has two queries that use the same words in opposite order and two passages, one answering each direction. A query succeeds when its intended passage outscores the other passage. A pair succeeds when both directions succeed. A pure bag-of-tokens encoder gives both queries the same vector, so it can succeed on at most one direction per pair.
